name: SmartAsset
desc:
Client Experience Specialist | $45,000 annual base salary + Bonuses | https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/smartasset/jobs/8579105002  

Job Summary
This is a high-volume outbound customer engagement and appointment-setting role for SmartAsset's financial advisor matching platform. Client Experience Specialists contact consumers who have already expressed interest in speaking with a financial advisor, answer questions, build trust, and schedule consultations. While not a traditional sales role, success is heavily tied to conversion rates, quotas, and performance metrics.
 Expected Realistic Duties
 Make 200+ outbound calls per day to interested consumers. 
 Contact users who have requested information about financial advisors. 
 Explain the advisor matching process and answer questions. 
 Build rapport and encourage users to schedule advisor consultations. 
 Follow approved scripts while personalizing conversations. 
 Track all interactions and outcomes in the CRM system. 
 Meet daily, weekly, and monthly conversion goals. 
 Identify customer concerns and barriers to scheduling. 
 Escalate recurring issues and provide feedback to leadership. 
 Participate in team initiatives and process improvements. 
 Maintain productivity in a fast-paced, metric-driven environment.
skills:

notes: This role is best described as an outbound appointment-setting position rather than traditional customer service. Representatives spend most of their day making outbound calls to consumers who have already shown interest in financial advisor services and guiding them toward scheduling a consultation. The strongest candidates will have outbound call center, appointment-setting, lead generation, inside sales, or customer engagement experience. Participants must be comfortable with high call volumes, conversion metrics, and performance expectations. The role offers a competitive compensation package with benefits, stock participation, and growth opportunities within a rapidly growing financial technology company.
